title: O14 IME increment-2 audit: raw codepoint verification
result: PASS — all 7 audit items proven from raw probe evidence
production_code_changed_note: Only O14ImeTest.kt modified. No changes to InputContract, ClientDisplayHost, ClientImeView, ImeCharMap, the Win32 probe, or any production file.

breakdown.source: held KEYCODE_W pressed in step 6 → WM_CHAR('w')

charCount_reconciliation.note: charCount=29 is fully accounted for: 1 (baseline 'a') + 22 (phrase) + 1 (Enter CR) + 2 (Backspace) + 2 ('a','b' from 'a中b') + 1 ('w' from held key) = 29. No unexplained WM_CHAR events.

2_uppercase_no_shift_held.evidence: finalModMask=0 (X server keyboard modifier mask is zero after all IME commits including uppercase P, R and shifted symbols). The winlator Keyboard.onKeyEvent path injects Shift on DOWN and releases it on UP for every shifted character.

3_enter_reached_probe.evidence: codepoint 13 (CR) at position [23] in CHAR stream. Sent via KEYCODE_ENTER through contract.key(). Note: imeCommit('\n') correctly rejects U+000A because newline is not a printable character; Enter is a key action, not committed text.

4_backspace_reached_probe.evidence: codepoints 8,8 at positions [24,25] in CHAR stream. Wine's TranslateMessage produces WM_CHAR(8) for VK_BACK. Two imeDelete(2) calls produced exactly 2 Backspace WM_CHAR events.

5_unsupported_rejected_before_partial.evidence: imeCommit('a中b') returned rejected=[20013] (U+4E2D 中), accepted=[a,b]. codepoint 20013 does NOT appear in the CHAR stream. The 'a' and 'b' around it DID arrive (positions 26,27). No partial injection of the rejected character.

6_no_duplicate_wm_char.evidence: phraseOccurrences=1 — the exact 22-char phrase subsequence appears exactly once in the CHAR stream. No character is duplicated.

7_final_state_neutral.evidence: finalModMask=0 (no Shift/Ctrl/Alt held), finalReleaseKeyCount=0 (no held keys), finalReleaseButtonCount=0 (no held buttons).

test_defect_found_and_fixed.description: The original test committed Enter as imeCommit('\n'). Newline (U+000A) is correctly rejected by ImeCharMap because it is not a printable character. The audit-enhanced test sends Enter as KEYCODE_ENTER through the contract's key path, which is the correct architecture. This was a test defect, not a production defect — production behavior is correct.

backspace_assumption_corrected.description: The original test assumed Backspace only produces WM_KEYDOWN, not WM_CHAR. Wine's TranslateMessage actually produces both WM_KEYDOWN(VK_BACK) and WM_CHAR(8) for Backspace. The audit-enhanced test verifies Backspace via the CHAR stream (codepoint 8), which is the stronger proof.
